question: The record for yike-album names www.yike.com, which did not answer a probe from this vantage (a reset on one try, a timeout on the next). The album's own page is yike.baidu.com, titled as a claim of unlimited album space. Should the record's url move to yike.baidu.com, and does the sign-up need only a Baidu account, with originals returned unre-encoded?
why: Only the page title was read. The account requirement, the per-file type restriction and the re-encode behaviour are behind a sign-up and stay unverified.
